findings.title: Missing React key on Grafana list item
findings.body: In FilterViewResults the grafana branch renders <GrafanaRuleListItem> without key={key} while the datasource and unknown branches do pass key. Without a stable key React cannot reconcile the infinite-scroll list correctly, causing duplicate-key warnings, wrong item reuse/state preservation and extra re-mounts when pages load.

findings.title: Pause action can never show in ruler-less list view
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu computes canPause as ruler-ability OR grafana-prom-ability to support the list view without ruler data, but the Pause menu item is still gated on rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule). When rulerRule is undefined (the new list view) that predicate is false, so Pause is never rendered even when canPause is true via promRule. Users with pause permission lose the Pause/Unpause action.

findings.title: Silence drawer never opens for prom-only rules
findings.body: RuleActionsButtons allows Silence via useGrafanaPromRuleAbility on promRule alone, calling setShowSilenceDrawer(true), but the drawer is rendered only if rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) where rule is the optional RulerRuleDTO. In the new Grafana list view rule is undefined, so the condition is always false and clicking Silence does nothing. The menu offers an action that has no effect.

findings.title: Federated rule protection removed
findings.body: useAllRulerRuleAbilities previously set immutableRule using isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) to block Edit/Delete/Pause on federated Mimir groups. The PR replaces it with const isFederated = false with a TODO. Federated groups are now treated as mutable, so users will be offered Edit/Delete/Pause on rules that must be immutable, risking failed API calls or unintended mutations.

findings.title: Provisioned check fails open when provenance missing
findings.body: isProvisionedPromRule returns Boolean(promRule.provenance) and the new provenance field on GrafanaPromRuleDTOBase is optional. Any response without that field (older server, cache, mock) evaluates to false, so provisioned Grafana rules are classified as editable/removable/pausable. Combined with the new prom-only abilities path, provisioned rules can show Edit/Duplicate/Delete/Pause in the list view.

findings.title: Creating/deleting states silently dropped
findings.body: GrafanaGroupLoader no longer fetches the ruler group or runs matchRules. Rules that exist only in ruler (just created, Prometheus not yet synced) now disappear entirely instead of showing Creating, and rules deleted from ruler but still in Prometheus now render as normal instead of Deleting. Users see stale normal rows that will fail on edit/delete, or missing rows with no explanation.

findings.title: Prom-only non-Grafana rules lose all actions
findings.body: getEditableIdentifier returns undefined for a prom-only rule that is not a Grafana prom rule, and RuleActionsButtons returns null in that case. That removes the entire Stack including the More menu (Copy link, Silence, etc.), not just Edit. Any consumer rendering a cloud Prometheus-only rule without ruler data gets no actions at all.
